card.title: Believe This with Me
card.instruction: Recruit someone into treating your impossible explanation as the most useful version of events.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The office kettle's on strike. Help me negotiate before the clients arrive.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've filled it twice. It still won't boil.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then water isn't its grievance. Tell it we'll stop leaving it alone after meetings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can take it into the meeting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Give it my chair. A seat at the table should get us tea.

mechanism: A enlists B to solve kettle failure by treating it as a labor grievance deserving inclusion.
confusable: Unlike ordinary personification, A must recruit concrete cooperation with the impossible explanation.
comparison: An offered meeting visit becomes representation at the table, unlike using a surveyor's truck to guide a house.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
